Narrative 2: I opted to buy my own worms for fishing instead of stealing some from work.
Narrative 3: I used a lure when I went fishing instead of using worms.

Title: Lost Work
Body: After writing an hour of nonstop, high quality content, your computer crashes and you lose everything you just wrote.
Choice 1: Rewrite it while it's fresh in my mind
Narrative 1: I immediately rewrote some work I lost after my computer crashed.
Narrative 2: I took a break after losing an hour's worth of work when my computer crashed.
Narrative 3: I called in a tech savvy friend to help me recover an hour's worth of lost work.

Title: Writer's Block
Body: You are experiencing writer's block and are having a hard time being productive.
Narrative 1: I caffeinated myself with a latte in an attempt to stimulate my writing after experiencing writer's block.
Narrative 2: I started reading my favorite author in an attempt to get my creative juices flowing again after experiencing writer's block.
Narrative 3: I took the rest of the day off after I began experiencing writer's block.

Title: Witches' Brew
Body: You have to decide which ingredient you are going to add to your cauldron to perfect your witches' brew.
Narrative 1: I added a snake to my cauldron in an attempt to make my witches' brew more potent. Sadly, the potion came out weak.
Narrative 2: I added some bat testicles to my cauldron in an attempt to make my witches' brew more potent. It worked tremendously well!
Narrative 3: I added a dragon's scale to my cauldron in an attempt to make my witches' brew more potent. The potion improved tremendously!
Narrative 4: I added some magic mushrooms to my cauldron to experiment with my potion. It came out totally unusable.

Title: Black Carpet Event
Body: You have to decide which model of broom you will use to get to an important witchcraft event.
Narrative 1: I rode a black Rubbermaid FG637400BLA lobby broom to a witchcraft event, which I got to safely and comfortably.
Narrative 2: I rode a Super Sweep 48\u201d broom to a witchcraft event because I wanted to impress those in attendance with the size and power of my vehicle, while compensating for my other shortcomings.
Narrative 3: I rode a beige Huibot hand broom to a witchcraft event because I wanted to get there as efficiently as possible, while limiting my ecological footprint.
Narrative 4: I couldn't find a broom I wanted to ride so I stayed home instead of going to a witchcraft event.

Title: Witch-Hunt
Body: You catch wind that there are people in your area looking to persecute witches by burning them at the stake.
Choice 1: Go into hiding as a nun in a convent
Narrative 1: I hid out in a convent and pretended to be a nun in order to avoid being persecuted in a widespread witch-hunt.
Narrative 2: I hid out during a witch-hunt to prevent anything bad from happening to me.
Narrative 3: I exposed the persons responsible for leading a witch-hunt, which resulted in their imprisonment and prevented any witches from being burned at the stake.
Narrative 4: I decided that I would be true to myself and accept whatever comes my way during a witch-hunt.

Title: Small-Scale Sniffer
Body: You are looking in the mirror and starting to feel insecure because you think your nose is too small.
Narrative 1: I used a black magic wand and some sorcery to give myself an elite witch nose.
Narrative 2: I drank a concoction I made in a cauldron using my nose hairs, Viagra, and witch hazel in the hopes of making my nose more witchlike. It didn't work!
Narrative 3: I had plastic surgery, which added some length, girth, and warts to my nose. It made me look wicked awesome!
Narrative 4: I decided to accept my nose as it is and to embrace the fact that my talents, not my appearance, are what make me an excellent witch.

Title: Malevolent
Body: You and your coven are attending a black-tie social event when some of the witches in your coven start being catty.
CTA: How will you deal with it?
Narrative 1: I joined in on some evil trash talk and gossiped with the other witches in my coven.
Narrative 2: I decided to rise above some pettiness and ignore gossip that was going on in my coven.
Choice 3: Put a spell on those witches
Narrative 3: I used some sorcery to put a spell on some witches in my coven that were being spiteful.
Narrative 4: I confronted some bitchy witches in my coven for being venomously wicked.

Title: Invitation Only
Body: You're trying to get into a house to suck some blood, but first you have to figure out a way to get invited into the home.
Narrative 1: I posed as a Jehovah's Witness in an attempt to get invited into a home where I was hoping to suck some blood. The door was shut in my face!
Choice 2: Pretend to be a pizza delivery person
Narrative 2: I used a pepperoni pizza to manipulate my way into a victim's home, where I then proceeded to drink his blood.
Narrative 3: I directly asked if I could enter a home to suck some blood. I was not invited in.
Narrative 4: I was denied access to a potential victim's home when I posed as an internet technician.

Title: Duty Calls
Body: You need to go to the dentist, but it's only open during the day when the sun is typically shining.
Narrative 1: In an attempt to avoid deadly sun exposure, I waited for a rainy day to go for a walk-in appointment at my dentist's office.
Narrative 2: I took a fully tinted limo from my home to my dentist's office, and I used an umbrella to avoid sun exposure while getting in and out of the car.
Choice 3: Wear a Little Red Riding Hood costume
Narrative 3: I wore a Little Red Riding Hood costume so that I could go to the dentist on a bright, sunny day. The dentist cleaned my teeth, but treated me like a weirdo!
Narrative 4: I kept my fangs pearly white and avoided dangerous sunlight by scheduling a twilight appointment with my dentist.

Title: Laid to Rest
Body: You are in the market for a new place to rest because you haven't been sleeping well.
Narrative 1: I purchased a rust-resistant stainless steel casket in hopes of improving the quality of my sleep.
Narrative 2: I purchased an elegantly crafted mahogany casket to start getting better rest during the day.
Narrative 3: I purchased an eco-friendly wicker coffin to improve my quality of sleep, and to reduce my ecological footprint.
Narrative 4: I bought a Craftmatic Adjustable Bed and some blackout curtains as an alternative to sleeping in a casket. I miss that claustrophobic feeling!

Title: High Stakes
Body: While high upon a rooftop in the night, <a lawyer/a police officer/a cowboy/a pilot/a homeless man/a professional athlete/a tech bro/a hipster/a DJ/a doctor/a porn star/a rapper/an old man/a surfer/a biker> attempts to kill you by sticking a silver stake through your heart. Luckily, he misses and grazes your skin.
Narrative 1: I bit <rb> who tried to stick my heart with a silver stake, before transforming into a bat and flying off into the night.
Narrative 2: I used my super strength to yeet <rb> off a building after he tried to drive a stake through my heart. I missed the opportunity to suck his blood.
Choice 3: Bite him, then give him garlic
Narrative 3: I bit <rb> who tried to drive a stake in my heart. Then later, after he had transformed, I had garlic bread delivered to him in an attempt to poison him.\240

Title: Stakeout
Body: You're craving some human blood and have to decide where you will prey on humans.
Narrative 1: I went to a graveyard at night to drink some blood, but there were no visitors, so I went home hungry.
Narrative 2: I hid out and feasted all night on visitors who came through a haunted house, after I was able to convince a staff member that I was an employee.
Narrative 3: I tried going to an underground night club to drink human blood, but it was dead. Instead, I crushed a Bloody Mary, tipped the bartender with the end of my fangs, and went home to read \u201cTwilight\u201d.
Narrative 4: I got several private dances at a seedy strip club, each time draining blood from the exotic dancer.

Title: Human Platter
Body: You are on a train with a delicious spread of humans before your eyes.
CTA: Which one will you try to eat?
Narrative 1: I ate the brains of a police officer while on a train.
Narrative 2: I ate the brains of a politician while on a train. Just doing my part!
Narrative 3: I ate the brains of a skater while on a train. It tasted like weed!
Narrative 4: I ate the brains of a CEO while on a train.

Title: Flesh Wound
Body: While attempting to feast on the brains of a Karen, she chops off your <hand/arm/fingers/leg/foot/toes/ear/nose> with <an axe/a meat clever/a hunting knife/a power saw/a longsword/a broadsword/a saber/a machete/a battle axe/a scythe/a sickle/a bayonet>.
Choice 1: Cut off her <rb>, then eat her brains
Narrative 1: I took a weapon from a Karen and used it to cut off her <rb>, then dined on her brains.
Narrative 2: I ate the flesh and brains of a Karen who cut off my <rb>.
Narrative 3: I ran away from a Karen after she cut off my <rb>.
Narrative 4: I decided to find an easier human meal after a Karen cut off my <rb>.

Title: Headgear
Body: You have to decide what kind of headwear you will get to protect a human from decapitating you.
Narrative 1: I got a football helmet to protect my head while trying to eat humans, but learned that the mask makes it difficult to bite them.
Narrative 2: I got myself a construction hard hat to protect my head while eating humans.
Narrative 3: I got a motorcycle helmet to protect myself from aggressive humans, but I stopped wearing it because it made my hair super frizzy.
Narrative 4: I got a cycling helmet to protect myself from aggressive humans but ditched it after I realized how dumb I looked.

Title: Sauce It Up
Body: You are getting sick and tired of eating human flesh and brains with just blood sauce, so you are thinking about mixing in a new sauce.
Narrative 1: I started drenching human brains in ranch dressing to add a little zest to the flavor.
Narrative 2: I started drenching human brains in oil and vinegar to add a little more flavor while keeping it healthy.
Narrative 3: I started drenching human brains in Tabasco hot sauce to add a little spiciness to the flavor. I'm hooked on hot brains!
Narrative 4: I started drenching human brains in a lemon-dill aioli sauce to add a little sour tang to the flavor. I just can't get enough!

Title: Scary Movie
Body: You have some time to kill between hunting humans, and you're thinking about catching a flick.
Narrative 1: I learned a thing or two about how to hunt humans while watching \u201cDawn of the Dead\u201d on the big screen.
Narrative 2: I acquired a lot of awesome zombie wisdom and learned new techniques by watching \u201c28 Days Later\u201d on the big screen.
Narrative 3: I kicked up my feet and enjoyed watching \u201cZombieland\u201d on the big screen. I didn't learn much that I could apply to my career, but I had a fun time!
Narrative 4: I was in stitches while watching \u201cShaun of the Dead\u201d on the big screen.

Title: Gettin' Dizzy
Body: You're on a training mission aboard a Chinook helicopter when suddenly one of the engines blows out, and the craft begins to gyrate wildly.
Narrative 1: I jumped out of a Chinook helicopter when one of the engines blew out.
Narrative 2: When one of the engines blew out during a Chinook helicopter training, I held tight knowing there were two engines.
Narrative 3: I screamed in panic when one of the engines blew out on our Chinook helicopter during a training exercise.

Title: Foreign Attack
Body: While enjoying some leave in the port city of a foreign country, you witness a man beating another man in the face with a bamboo stick.
Narrative 1: I broke up a fight between two locals while on leave in a foreign country.
Narrative 2: I looked the other way when I observed two locals fighting while on leave in a foreign country.
Narrative 3: I helped a man beat another man in the face with a bamboo stick while on leave in a foreign country.

Title: Jet Set Joyride
Body: A fellow airman says he can easily hotwire an F-16 fighter jet for a quick joyride at Mach speeds, and asks if you want to join in the fun.
Narrative 1: I went for a joyride in an F-16 at mach speeds with a fellow airman who hotwired the jet.
Narrative 2: I advised a fellow airman against hotwiring an F-16 for a joyride at Mach speeds.
Narrative 3: I reported to my commanding officer an airman who wanted to hotwire an F-16 to take it on a joyride.

Title: Jet Set Joyride
Body: You discover that one of your airman just hotwired an F-16 fighter jet and is currently on a joyride with another airman at Mach speeds.
Narrative 1: I hopped in an F-15E and chased down some airmen who hotwired an F-16 and took it on a joyride.
Narrative 2: I didn't do anything when a couple of my airmen hotwired an F-16 and took it on a joyride. I wanted them to have a little fun.
Narrative 3: I established radio communication with some airmen who took an F-16 on a joyride and commanded they return to base immediately.

Title: Negative, Ghost Rider
Body: One of your airman requests a tower flyby, but the pattern is full, so you deny his request. A minute later, you're abruptly startled as the fighter jet passes by at 400 knots, causing you to spill coffee on your uniform.
Narrative 1: I put one of my airmen in hack after he buzzed the tower at 400 knots.
Narrative 2: After an airman buzzed the tower at 400 knots, I told him that his ego was writing checks his body couldn't cash.
Narrative 3: I just laughed it off when one of my airmen buzzed the tower at 400 knots, causing me to spill coffee all over my uniform.

Title: Inflight Proposition
Body: While conducting a fighter jet training mission with one of your enlistees in the rear seat, you suddenly feel a finger tickling your neck as he asks if you'd like to join the mile-high club.
Narrative 1: I giggled like a schoolgirl when an enlistee tickled my neck from the rear seat of our fighter jet, asking if I'd like to join the mile-high club.
Narrative 2: I put a fighter jet into a nosedive after an enlistee tickled my neck from the rear seat, asking if I wanted to join the mile-high club.
Narrative 3: I prematurely landed a fighter jet and ran into a bunkhouse with an enlistee who had just propositioned me from the rear seat.

Title: March Madness
Body: After five grueling miles of marching in the desert, your mind is delirious, your feet are blistering, and you're falling behind the rest of your platoon.
Narrative 1: I kept the pain to myself when marching in the desert with my mind delirious and my feet blistering.
Narrative 2: The pain was so intense from marching in the desert that I fell to the ground, unable to walk another step.
Narrative 3: I experienced extreme fatigue while marching in the desert but pushed through it to keep up with my platoon.

Title: Jammed
Body: Your platoon is taking heavy fire when suddenly your M4 rifle jams.
Narrative 1: I slapped my M4 magazine back into action after it malfunctioned under heavy fire.
Narrative 2: I pulled the charging handle to clear my M4 back after it malfunctioned under heavy fire.
Narrative 3: I grabbed my backup pistol after my M4 malfunctioned under heavy fire.
Narrative 4: I stood up and ran for my life after my M4 malfunctioned under heavy fire.

Title: Don't Touch
Body: You're working with the local militia on intelligence gathering when you discover what appears to be an IED. Suddenly, a fellow soldier reaches down to pick it up.
Narrative 1: I ran for my life after witnessing a fellow soldier reach down to pick up an IED.
Narrative 2: I quickly pushed a fellow soldier away from an IED that she was about to pick up.
Narrative 3: I screamed at a fellow soldier to STOP just before she was about to pick up an IED.

Title: Foot Soldier Fight
Body: While finishing up some paperwork one evening, you overhear two of your soldiers fighting over <the last cinnamon roll/the TV remote/who won at ping pong/who's more ripped/who can do more push ups>. You look up from your work to witness one of them punch the other in the face.
Narrative 1: I broke up a fight between two of my soldiers who were fighting over <rb>.
Narrative 2: I joined in a fight with two of my soldiers over <rb>.
Narrative 3: I ignored a fight between two of my soldiers who were fighting over <rb>.

Title: Question Authority
Body: While delivering a battlefield strategy, one of your soldiers begins to challenge your tactics in front of the platoon.
Narrative 1: I ignored a soldier who challenged my battlefield tactics in front of my platoon.
Narrative 2: I called a soldier a useless maggot after she challenged my battlefield tactics in front of my platoon.
Narrative 3: I asked a soldier for suggestions on how to better strategize after she challenged my battlefield tactics in front of the platoon.

Title: VR Games
Body: The military just released new virtual reality training scenarios, and it's some of the most high-tech stuff you've ever seen. Your platoon is excited to start the new training and is asking which module is first.
Narrative 1: I chose a Hostage Incidents VR module to train my platoon.
Narrative 2: I chose a Vehicle Checkpoints VR module to train my platoon.
Narrative 3: I chose an Ambushes VR module to train my platoon.
Narrative 4: I chose a Marksmanship VR module to train my platoon.

Title: Sea Sick
Body: While performing your duties on deck at sea, you suddenly feel nauseous but are too embarrassed to vomit in front of your shipmates.
CTA: Where will you toss your cookies?
Narrative 1: Out of embarrassment, I vomited inside my uniform so that the other guardsmen wouldn't know that I had become seasick.
Narrative 2: I quickly vomited over the side of the ship so that the other guardsmen wouldn't know that I had become seasick.
Narrative 3: Out of embarrassment, I vomited inside my mouth so that the other guardsmen wouldn't know that I had become seasick.

Title: Shark Bait
Body: Your commanding officer informs the team of a life-threatening rescue mission in shark-infested waters and is asking for volunteers.
Narrative 1: I volunteered for a life-threatening rescue mission in shark-infested waters.
Narrative 2: I hid in the latrine when our commanding officer asked for volunteers on a life-threatening rescue mission in shark-infested waters.
Narrative 3: I volunteered a fellow guardsman when our commanding officer asked for volunteers on a life-threatening rescue mission in shark-infested waters.

Title: Loose Bag
Body: While assisting in a drug bust on a smuggler's boat at sea, you discover a small bag of cocaine on your own, when nobody else is around.
Narrative 1: I found a small bag of cocaine during a drug bust and immediately stuffed it in my underpants before anyone saw.
Narrative 2: I found a small bag of cocaine during a drug bust and immediately snorted it all before anyone noticed.
Narrative 3: I found a small bag of cocaine during a drug bust and immediately turned it in.

Title: Join Me If You Can
Body: While patrolling the waters just offshore, you notice a yacht sailing in a suspicious manner. Upon approach, you witness Leonardo DiCaprio on deck, with a bottle of Dom in his hand, surrounded by bikini-clad nymphs. They yell out for you to come join the party.
Narrative 1: I decided to further inspect a suspicious yacht after witnessing Leonardo DiCaprio on deck drinking champagne surrounded by bikini-clad nymphs.
Narrative 2: Leonardo DiCaprio invited me to party with him and some bikini-clad nymphs on his yacht, but I chose instead to smile and wave as we passed his vessel.
Narrative 3: I got an autograph from Leonardo DiCaprio while inspecting his yacht for sailing in a suspicious manner.
Narrative 4: I partied on a yacht with Leonardo DiCaprio and his bikini-clad nymphs.

Title: Close Encounters
Body: While patrolling the waters late at night, you blink your eyes in disbelief, witnessing what you swear is <a sea monster/a UFO/the ghost of Davy Jones>, but then it's gone.

Narrative 2: I yelled for backup after witnessing what I thought was <rb> from the deck of our ship at night.
Narrative 3: I simply ignored what I thought was <rb> after witnessing it from the deck of our ship at night.

Title: Swimming with Sharks
Body: While searching the waters for a great white shark that attacked a surfer, you discover a dorsal fin not far off. Your commanding officer asks if you'll hop in the water to get a visual on the beast.
Narrative 1: I faked a stomach cramp to get out of swimming in the water with a great white shark.
Narrative 2: I jumped in the water to get a visual on a great white shark that had attacked a surfer.
Narrative 3: I played a game of roshambo with my commanding officer to decide who would swim with a great white shark.

Title: Mud Pie
Body: You're wading through thick mud on a training mission when suddenly your boot slips off, disappearing in the wet sludge.
Narrative 1: My boot got stuck in the mud and came off my foot during training, so I took the other boot off to match.
Narrative 2: I recovered a boot that came off my foot in thick mud during a training exercise.
Narrative 3: I left my boot behind after it got stuck in the mud during a training exercise.

Title: Seal Superiority

Narrative 2: I ignored an obnoxious SEAL who tried to eat my carrot cake.
Narrative 3: I told a Navy SEAL that he was a pathetic loser for trying to bully me out of my carrot cake.

Narrative 2: I got a tattoo across my chest that says Semper Fi.
Narrative 3: I got a tattoo across my shoulder that says MOM inside a heart.
Narrative 4: I decided not to join my fellow marines in getting a tattoo.

Title: Crocodile Tears

Narrative 2: I told a soldier who broke down crying that if he didn't stop, there would be no mercy in my punishment.
Narrative 3: I left behind a soldier who broke down crying in a swamp during our training exercise.

Narrative 3: After noticing how hot an enlistee looked in wet fatigues, I asked if I could lend a hand in any way possible.

Narrative 3: I found a bottle of <rb> during bunk inspections but decided not to do anything about it.

Title: Exotic Locations

Narrative 2: I told my shipmates that I hoped we would be deployed to New Zealand.
Narrative 3: I told my shipmates that I hoped we would be deployed to England.
Narrative 4: I told my shipmates that I hoped we would be deployed to South Korea.

Narrative 2: I helped a delirious sailor get to sick bay.
Narrative 3: I met a sailor who was so high on paint fumes that I decided to join in and huff paint with him.

Title: Leftovers Again
Body: After <num45-75> days on a submarine, some of your fellow sailors start complaining about not having any more fresh chow to eat. The submarine chef asks what you think he should cook from the remaining loadout.
Narrative 1: I told the submarine chef that canned boiled potatoes would make some good chow for the sailors.
Narrative 2: I told the submarine chef that three bean salad would make some good chow for the sailors.
Narrative 3: I told the submarine chef that fresh biscuits would make some good chow for the sailors.
Narrative 4: I told the submarine chef that fried spam would make some good chow for the sailors.

Body: After seven sexless months at sea, you find yourself fantasizing about a particular enlistee aboard the ship. But as a Naval officer, you know any form of advancement would be a career killer.

Narrative 2: I established covert communications with an attractive enlistee whom I had been fantasizing over.
Narrative 3: I found myself fantasizing over a particular enlistee aboard our ship and immediately took a cold shower to get it out of my head.

Title: Favorite Things
Body: A new enlistee on her first deployment asks what you enjoy most about being aboard a ship at sea.

Narrative 2: I told a new enlistee that conquering the vast open waters is the experience that I enjoy the most about being at sea.

Narrative 3: I told a new enlistee that sleeping on the world's largest waterbed is the experience that I enjoy the most about being at sea.

Narrative 4: I told a new enlistee that the smell of napalm in the morning is an experience that I enjoy the most about being at sea.

Title: Rest and Relaxation
Body: While at a port of call in <South Korea/Germany/Singapore/Australia/England/New Zealand/Canada>, a fellow shipmate asks if you want to join him for some "R&R" at a local strip club.
Narrative 1: A fellow shipmate asked me to join him for some R&R at a strip club, and I said, let's hit that!

Narrative 3: I got the autograph of <celebrity-female> when she asked if I could bake a vegan cake for a friend's birthday.
Choice 4: I'm not a fan of your work

Narrative 2: I baked some sweet buttered muffins for <friend-possessive> family reunion, and they put everyone in a really good mood.
Narrative 3: I baked some pot brownies for <friend-possessive> family reunion, and they put everyone in a really good mood.
Narrative 4: I baked banana-shaped banana cakes, with nuts, for <friend-possessive> family reunion, and they put everyone in a really good mood.

Body: You bake signature buns for a restaurant that was recently awarded the best burger in town. In a magazine article, the restaurant praises your buns for being the perfect size and softness to complement their juicy patties.
Narrative 1: I thanked the best-burger-in-town restaurant for showering my buns with wonderful compliments.
Narrative 2: I decided to brand my buns after being recognized as the official bun-baker of the best burger in town.
Narrative 3: I cherished my buns for being the perfect size, texture, and softness to complement the best burger in town.
